text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zeroual has postponed plan to widen government for opposition parties to save dynamic of political understanding reached in national conference.
- Algeria's soccer junior squad plays Tunisian team on Friday in Algiers for African Football Cup match.
- Algeria urges international community to join forces in forging better balanced international economic order.
- Government grants permission for setting up first free zone in eastern region of Bellara.
- Prime Minister Ouyahia visits Biskra and El Oued provinces.
